address: 5 Mu 9, Nong Tamlueng, Phan Thong, Chon Buri, 20160, Thailand
bio: This country-style restaurant serves up a splendid array of Isan dishes and Eastern Thai specialties from land and sea. The highlight is a spicy stir-fry with an original curry paste recipe from Chanthaburi province, capturing the authentic essence of Thai cuisine. There's no compromise on bold, genuine Thai flavours. The tranquil outdoor setting affords views of lush green rice fields, and the relaxed atmosphere makes it perfect for friend and family gatherings....
